description: Attempt a soft intercept/catch of a colored object in a tight catch volume. Motion is disabled by default; hard speed/volume/session caps and an explicit safety acknowledgment are required before any catch move.

models.markdown_description: DoCommand: `preview` (track only), `arm_ready` (slow move to ready pose), `catch` (requires `enable_catch` + safety ack), `abort` (stop arm). Soft throws only; refuses fast/out-of-volume trajectories.
